subject: pol-con
title: POL.CON. ------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-6 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic of the move toward non-functionalism: 'I believe that the move towards non-functionalism in the seventies is directly related to the realness of both spectacle diversion progressionalism … as well as the aspect-essence distortions which came to permeate composite information dissemination.' POL-CON (political consciousness) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality): the question is what political-consciousness produces when crossed with social-reality — under conditions where aspect-essence distortions have come to permeate information dissemination. INFO-INTR (information interpretation) branches from the main line and carries (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation). INFO-F (information focus) also branches from the main line and carries RT-DYM (reality dynamics). SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) branches from the main line as well and leads to POL-P (political policies), then to C-CONT (composite continuance), then to MT-INFO (multi-information) and on to CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions).
